entries.text: Man, it’s been a while since I’ve been here. And\neveryone’s been talking to me like normal...\r\nI honestly wasn’t expecting that.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_01

entries.text: Well, everyone but Drayton. He was looking at\nme with a stupid grin on his face...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_02

entries.text: But I still apologized to him—for everything I did,\nand how I acted...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_03

entries.text: I’m glad things are working out!
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_select_01

entries.text: You two getting along?
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_select_02

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Yeah, me too! It’s all thanks to you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_04

entries.text: Can’t really say we’re buddy-buddy just yet,\nbut...yeah. I’ll keep trying...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_04b

entries.text: I’m gonna make up for the time I lost while I was\naway from school—just you watch![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp01_05

entries.text: Hey, thanks for bringing Arven and everyone with\nyou to Kitakami.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_00

entries.text: Being back home on my break, I just couldn’t\nstop dwelling on everything that had happened...\r\nIt was rough...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_01

entries.text: You guys visiting really helped.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_02

entries.text: It’s too bad all that weird stuff happened while\nyou guys were there, though...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_03

entries.text: The weird stuff with Carmine?
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_select_03

entries.text: The weird “mochi mochi” stuff?
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_select_04

entries.text: Yeah, that! My sis is still all embarrassed ’bout it,\nso you better not bring that stuff up around her![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_05

entries.text: Yeah, that! It makes for a funny story now, but\nwowzers, that was scary![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_05b

entries.text: Y’know, there’s something I’ve been thinking\nabout for a while and...I think I made up my mind.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_06

entries.text: I’ll fill you in soon, I promise. Just wait a bit, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp02_07

entries.text:

entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_00

entries.text: Wait, why’d you do that?!
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_01

entries.text: Did you get sick of it?
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_02

entries.text: Don’t worry, it’s not ’cause of you—or anybody\nin the club.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_01

entries.text: I just wanted to become as strong as you so\nbadly... It was all I cared about. Up till now, I’d\r\nforgotten that battling is supposed to be fun.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_02

entries.text: So I wanna do some thinking about what I really\nwanna do.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_03

entries.text: I think for now I wanna just be around friends and\nPokémon and not get so caught up in competing.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_04

entries.text: Guess you thought it through!
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_03

entries.text: Do what you gotta do!
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_04

entries.text: Heh... Thanks.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_05

entries.text: Only thing that’s changed is that you’re the\nChampion now—the Elite Four lineup is still\r\nthe same. Crispin’s pretty relieved.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_06

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]But just because you got to the top doesn’t mean\nyou get to slack off, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_07

entries.text: Once I’ve cleared my head a bit, I’m gonna\nshoot for that Champion title again![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_08

entries.text: Looking forward to it!
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_05

entries.text: You still won’t beat me!
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_select_06

entries.text: Hehehe... Yeah, so am I![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_09

entries.text: Hehehe... If you say so![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_sp03_09b

entries.text: Ah, right—I do have a favor I wanna ask you...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_trade_01_00

entries.text: If it’s all right, do you wanna, um...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_trade_01_01

entries.text: Do you wanna trade Pokémon with me?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
